item.title: Verbose beta 241
item.description:
A new look, and fewer places to look

Mac

  • Home has the new look: a persimmon Record card, colored tiles, Recent, and This week. Click the Record card for a voice note, or right-click it for more ways to record. While you record, it becomes the recording, with Mark moment, Pause, and Stop and transcribe.
  • Palette offers full color or soft tints for the Record card and tiles. Soft trades the persimmon Record card and bright tiles for light tints of the same colors. Find it in Settings › Appearance on iPhone and Settings › Personalization and preferences on the Mac.
  • The Library is one table with colored kinds, quick filters, and sortable columns. Click a row to select it and double-click to open it, in both looks. The Table and List choice is gone, so every Library is the table.
  • Transcripts read in a centered serif column with speaker chips and a glass player. Original, Cleaned, Summary, and a template's result are tabs at the top. Share and More hold Copy, Export, Run a template, and the rest, and moments and details sit in the side column.
  • While you record, the toolbar shows the time with a Stop button. In Native, Record sits beside Back and Forward, so it stays in the toolbar in a narrow window with the inspector open.
  • The menu bar, meeting panel, bubble, and Live captions have the new look. The menu bar panel and the meeting panel show the recording as a small persimmon card, and the meeting banner uses the new cards and buttons.

Also on iPhone

  • Transcripts have the new look: serif text, colored speaker chips, and a glass player.
  • The recorder has the new look: the kind in serif and a persimmon clock.
  • Minimized, a recording shows its time with Pause and Stop above the tab bar.
